items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: With John Patterson. He was the leader of the band... And Miss Kemmel was playing piano.

ctx.x: Well I played there for about thirty-four months, you know.

With John Patterson. He was the leader of the band. What did he play? Tenor Saxophone. And Miss Kemmel was playing piano. Ginny. Wow. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. So, and, uh, Twat was on the piece and Joe Harris was on sax, and, um, who was playing trumpet? No, it wasn't you, no trumpet. There's something in the check TV's recording. Yeah. That was a good idea. Yeah. Running again.
So you brought us up to date on that now, all through your life. Who, who was your teacher? Willie Foster, he was there, right at 510 Coen Street. He was my first teacher.
